title: Governance at the Edge of Architecture: Regulating NeuroAI and Neuromorphic Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI governance, regulation, and technical auditing methods (such as efficiency and hardware metrics) for NeuroAI and neuromorphic systems. While it mentions ethical principles like transparency and 'ethical AI development' as part of the regulatory frameworks it analyzes, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
